Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity Chinese WeChat mini-program UI DESIGN BOARD for the existing Funbox 炸金花记分 feature. Two provided images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: image1 actual illustration atlas and image2 prior Mahjong UI board. Create NEW poker score screens using exact existing project visual style. Large canvas about 2400x1600, landscape, 4 equal large 390x820 mobile screens across, readable Simplified Chinese. Soft pale blue-gray board background, header FUNBOX / 炸金花记分 / UI V1. Screens occupy majority, no physical device cases, fine status bars WeChat navigation capsule. Project palette #f5f7fa canvas, white surfaces radius16, cobalt #2d5bff main buttons, ink #172139, secondary #7b879c, pastel peach #fff0ed, positive #278461, negative coral #ff765e. Chinese PingFang/MiSans, clear generous spacing. Funbox italic blue wordmark small. Soft chunky plastic 3D illustrations match existing atlas exactly: white red-black A K Q poker cards, coral disk, blue edged plus-minus score tile, white receipt with blue check. Small utility icons flat consistent rounded stroke. Illustrations small and never obscure controls. No green felt tables, gold casino decor, neon, holograms, generic dashboard charts, chat, jackpots or payments. Main experience is offline physical cards and synchronized scorekeeping, never virtual cards dealt by app.
IMPORTANT PRODUCT: one room contains many 场; a 场 contains many 圈. Blind follow=base, seen follow=base*2; pot displays points AND RMB at host rate ¥0.50 per point, set before start. Base cap20 blind20 seen40, before cap unlimited circles, after cap max3 FULL extra circles then forced physical showdown. Compare only at active<=configured threshold (example3); first pay exactly own follow once THEN select active opponent, tie initiator loses, loser out, continue next seat after initiator. Bonus separate from pot: any revealed 豹子 or 顺金 receives from every other participant including folded, regardless of winning. Host verifies in person and records after game. Ordinary 金花 no bonus. Room persists, no settlement after each game. User never needs select layout, responsive player grid based count 2-4=>2cols 5-8=>3cols 9-12=>4cols if fit. Full names in expandable detail. Seat order fixed, actor emphasized. Simplified Chinese labels exact, do not invent rules.
Use discreet visual documentation strip below screens only; annotations must not be inside user-facing UI. Footer 静态设计稿 · 数据为样例 · 动效见交互演示.
BOARD TITLE 01 建房与入桌. Four screens:
1 Home existing Funbox style, headline 牌友都在，清楚记分. Two familiar scenario cards Mahjong mint and Poker peach with atlas poker illustration, Poker now usable 炸金花 / 轮流跟注，清楚记账 / 开始牌局. Bottom tabs 首页 我的.
2 Create screen title 创建炸金花房间. Room name 老友局 and password666666 inline pencil editable, nickname小林 input. Organized compact WHITE sections 基础规则 with 底注1分, 每分金额 ¥0.50 /分, 基准单注封顶20分; show small helper 闷牌最高20分，看牌最高40分. 比牌规则 剩3人及以内可比牌 and 同大小主动方输 / 比牌先跟注，不另收费. 喜钱规则 豹子20分/人 顺金10分/人 with helper 亮牌即收，由房主核对. Pale blue notice 封顶前不限圈，封顶后最多再走3圈. Large 创建房间. Use compact fields, no total-round limit.
3 Invitation acceptance small atlas poker/link motif. Headline 牌友都在，等你入座. White card 老友局 / 炸金花记分 / 房主小林 / 6人已入桌. Verified pale blue 邀请已验证，无需房间码和密码. Nickname 阿杰, blue 确认加入; small helper 下场开始时参与，之前的账不分摊. Not payment.
4 Waiting room title 老友局 code628319 green实时同步, 8人已入座, small roomcode/sharing white card with ordinary illustrative QR no fancy framing. 玩家座位 section 3-column 8 compact cards ordered1小林房主2阿杰3小周4阿宁5老王6小陈7阿明8小赵. Rules summary ¥0.50/分 · 底注1分 · 基准封顶20分; 剩3人可比牌. Blue 开始第1场 plus secondary 管理玩家. Light host pending row 小李申请加入 / 查看. No disabled wait for maximum capacity; can start with>=2.
Bottom strip small UI snippets 密码加入 requires 房间码/密码/昵称; 已有身份一键回桌; 满员状态; 入座卡片轻弹240ms. Four screens strictly no unrelated alternate feature.

BOARD TITLE 02 本场记分与比牌. This is the central interaction board. Four screens consistent same room.
1 MY TURN screen 8 person grid 3cols. Compact room header 老友局 / 第4场·第2圈 / 7人在局8人入座. Prominent calm cobalt-tinted banner 轮到你了，小林 with rounded pointer icon, helper 闷牌跟10分，或加注、比牌条件满足时可选. Compact row 基准10分 / 本人应跟10分. 8 ordered seat cards white: seat1小林 我/行动中 pale blue outlined2px with once-pulse ring;2阿杰已看21分;3小周闷牌11分;4阿宁已弃牌1分 muted;5老王闷11;6小陈闷11;7阿明闷11;8小赵闷11. Total88. Below 展开完整明细. Bottom stable action area primary 跟注10分 (¥5.00 secondary in button), secondary 加注, tertiary 我已看牌/弃牌. No 比牌 button because7active>3. Every useful control legible.
2 WAITING OTHER screen same8 grid pot98分 ¥49.00 after小林follow10. Banner 轮到阿杰了 · 2号位, small 下一位小周. Seat2 outlinedblue actor mark, self小林 pale neutral我. Own action area shows 等待阿杰行动 and no own enabled follow button. Small badge 刚刚 小林跟注10分. Low emphasis 提醒一次 (no timer forfeit). Soft tip 自动同步，无需反复刷新.
3 COMPARE PREPAY threeactive condition. Main behind dim bottom sheet title 先跟注，再比牌, actor小林 target list NOT YET VISIBLE. Summary 本次跟注10分 / 折合¥5.00 / 计入公共积分池 / 不额外收比牌费. Fixed notice 跟注后才能选择对手. Blue 跟注10分，选择对手 and text 暂不比牌. Payment only once no real money movement UI.
4 COMPARE SELECT AND RESULT bottom sheet paid status 已跟注10分 / 已计入积分池. Heading 选择比牌对手, two selectable cards 2号 阿杰 / 3号 小周, 小周 selected; no out players or self. Title 现场比牌结果. Three radio options 小林大 / 小周大 / 同大小，主动方输; tie selected with coral explanatory strip 小林主动比牌，同大小判输并出局. Button 确认结果，轮到下一位. Below helper 下一位：阿杰（2号） / 不会再次扣分. No cancel after payment.
Bottom strip 4 brief visual frames: 刚轮到本人顶部横幅240ms attention; all see actor seat; 分数确认后更新+10 label once; 待同步 spinner button prevented duplicates. Include small offline banner 网络中断，操作已暂停 and 减少动态 setting. No fake countdown or automatic folding.
